run_benchmark_madrona_mjx: run the Madrona MJX benchmark CLI with environment name, number of environments, and measurement mode arguments
test_measurement_mode_state: test the MeasurementMode enum to select state-only benchmarking without vision rendering
test_measurement_mode_vision: test the MeasurementMode enum to select state and vision benchmarking with rendering
test_measurement_mode_inference: test the MeasurementMode enum to select state, vision, and neural network inference benchmarking
run_benchmark_bottleneck_mode: run the benchmark CLI with bottleneck mode enabled for CartpoleBalance or PandaPickCubeCartesian environments
